item.title: ००५ अयोध्यावर्णनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book I : Bala Kanda - The Youthful Majesties Verses converted to UTF_8 Sept, 09

We enter the capital of the Emperor Dasharatha. The pomp and glory of his capital is depicted along with its town planning and grandeur of the city, and its residents.

भागसूचना
  1. राजा दशरथद्वारा सुरक्षित अयोध्यापुरीका वर्णन
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Beginning the great narrative from Prajāpati Manu and Emperor Sagara of the Ikṣvāku race, the bards proclaim the Rāmāyaṇa and describe the prosperous land of Kosala along the Sarayū river and its world-renowned capital, Ayodhyā.

item.title: ००६ राजानुशासनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book I : Bala Kanda - Book Of Youthful Majesties Chapter [Sarga] 6

The riches and happiness enjoyed by the people, under the rein of Emperor Dasharatha, along with the details of its valiant heroes, elephants, horses and the town planning are narrated.

भागसूचना
  1. राजा दशरथके शासनकालमें अयोध्या और वहाँके नागरिकोंकी उत्तम स्थितिका वर्णन
त्र्यम्बकः - धर्माकूतम्

अतस् तत्-पितुर् दशरथस्य प्रभावः षष्ठे सर्गे वक्ष्यते -

item.title: ००७ मन्त्रिगुणगौरवम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book I : Bala Kanda - The Youthful Majesties

The truthful and upright characters of the ministers of Dasharatha are portrayed, who make the rulership meaningful with their virtuous, skilful and efficient administration. Along with the political ministers, the religious ministry is also portrayed.

भागसूचना
  1. राजमन्त्रियोंके गुण और नीतिका वर्णन
त्र्यम्बकः - धर्माकूतम्

तेषां गुणाः सप्तमे सर्गे -

सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

King Daśaratha is served by eight illustrious, incorruptible executive ministers headed by Dhṛṣṭi and Sumantra, alongside his revered royal preceptors Vasiṣṭha and Vāmadeva and six Brāhmaṇa sages headed by Suyajña and Jābāli.

item.title: ००८ अश्वमेधसन्नाहः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book I : Bala Kanda - The Youthful Majesties

Dasharatha decides to perform an elaborate Vedic ritual, called Aswamedha yajna, Horse Ritual, to beget children. He being a considerate king in taking conscience of the courtiers, he discusses this aspect with the Vedic scholars and ministers of his court, beforehand.

भागसूचना
  1. राजाका पुत्रके लिये अश्वमेधयज्ञ करनेका प्रस्ताव और मन्त्रियों तथा ब्राह्मणोंद्वारा उनका अनुमोदन
त्र्यम्बकः - धर्माकूतम्

एतादृशः पुत्रो नास्तीति अष्टम-सर्गे उक्तम् -

item.title: ००९ राज-सूत-संवादः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
भागसूचना
  1. सुमन्त्रका राजाको ऋष्यशृंग मुनिको बुलानेकी सलाह देते हुए उनके अंगदेशमें जाने और शान्तासे विवाह करनेका प्रसंग सुनाना
त्र्यम्बकः - धर्माकूतम्

नवम-सर्गे -

सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Speaking in private, the counselor-charioteer Sumantra recounts to King Daśaratha the ancient prophecy uttered by Bhagavān Sanatkumāra concerning Vibhāṇḍaka’s forest-reared son, Ṛśyaśṛṅga of twofold celibacy.

विश्वास-प्रस्तुतिः

एतच्छ्रुत्वा रहः सूतो राजानमिदमब्रवीत् ।
श्रूयतां तत् पुरावृत्तं पुराणे च मया श्रुतम् ॥ १ ॥

item.title: ०१० ऋष्यशृङ्गकथा
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book I : Bala Kanda - The Youthful Majesties Verses converted to UTF_8 Sept, 09

Sumantra, the minister continues his narration to his king Dasharatha, about Rishyashringa’s arrival at Anga kingdom of King Romapaada and his marriage with Princess Shantha, the daughter of Romapada.

भागसूचना
  1. अंगदेशमें ऋष्यशृंगके आने तथा शान्ताके साथ विवाह होनेके प्रसंगका कुछ विस्तारके साथ वर्णन
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

At Daśaratha’s request, Sumantra relates how Romapāda’s Purohita and ministers proposed sending richly adorned courtesans to entice the innocent forest ascetic Ṛśyaśṛṅga to the capital.

item.title: ०११ ऋष्यशृङ्गागमनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book I : Bala Kanda - The Youthful Majesties

On the advice of his minister Sumantra, Dasharatha proceeds to Anga kingdom to fetch Sage Rishyasringa and his wife Shanta to his capital Ayodhya.

भागसूचना
  1. सुमन्त्रके कहनेसे राजा दशरथका सपरिवार अंगराजके यहाँ जाकर वहाँसे शान्ता और ऋष्यशृंगको अपने घर ले आना
त्र्यम्बकः - धर्माकूतम्

एकादशे सर्गे-

सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Sumantra resumes the ancient prophecy of Bhagavān Sanatkumāra: how the righteous King Daśaratha of the Ikṣvāku line, bound in friendship with Romapāda of Aṅga to whom his daughter Śāntā was given, will journey to request Śāntā’s husband Ṛṣyaśṛṅga to conduct a sacrifice for the continuation of his lineage.

item.title: ०१२ अश्वमेधारम्भः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book I : Bala Kanda - The Youthful Majesties Verses converted to UTF_8 Sept, 09

King Dasharatha requests the Sages to conduct the Vedic ritual for which the sages indent paraphernalia, which the ministers are ordered to supply forthwith. This chapter is almost a replication of chapter 8, excepting the inclusion of references to Sage Rishyasringa who by now is available in Ayodhya.

भागसूचना
  1. राजाका ऋषियोंसे यज्ञ करानेके लिये प्रस्ताव, ऋषियोंका राजाको और राजाका मन्त्रियोंको यज्ञकी आवश्यक तैयारी करनेके लिये आदेश देना
त्र्यम्बकः - धर्माकूतम्

द्वादशे सर्गे -

item.title: ०१३ यज्ञशाला-प्रवेशः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book I : Bala Kanda - The Youthful Majesties

King Dasharatha requests Sage Vashishta, the Royal Priest to commence works for the Vedic ritual. Sage Vashishta instructs all the concerned about the discipline to be observed in executing the works. Sage Vashishta also instructs the minister Sumantra to invite various kings of other countries, and those kings will be received with great hospitality. King Dasharatha along with his wives takes ritual vow and enters ritual hall.

भागसूचना
  1. राजाका वसिष्ठजीसे यज्ञकी तैयारीके लिये अनुरोध, वसिष्ठजीद्वारा इसके लिये सेवकोंकी नियुक्ति और सुमन्त्रको राजाओंको बुलानेके लिये आदेश, समागत राजाओंका सत्कार तथा पत्नियोंसहित राजा दशरथका यज्ञकी दीक्षा लेना
त्र्यम्बकः - धर्माकूतम्

त्रयोदशे सर्गे-

item.title: ०१४ अश्वमेधयजनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book I : Bala Kanda - The Youthful Majesties

The Horse Ritual of Emperor Dasharatha is started on the banks of Sarayu River. The details of the arrangements for the participants, and visitors along with some aspects of the Vedic Ritual are narrated.

भागसूचना
  1. महाराज दशरथके द्वारा अश्वमेध यज्ञका सांगोपांग अनुष्ठान
त्र्यम्बकः - धर्माकूतम्

चतुर्दशे सर्गे -

सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Upon the completion of a full year and the safe return of the sacrificial steed, the great Aśvamedha sacrifice of King Daśaratha commences on the northern bank of the Sarayū under the direction of Ṛṣyaśṛṅga.

item.title: ०१५ पुत्रकामेष्टिः रावणवधचिन्ता
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book I : Bala Kanda - The Youthful Majesties Verses converted to UTF_8 Sept, 09

King Dasharatha commences the putrakaameSTi ritual aiming to beget progeny, under the aegis of Sage Rishyasringa. The celestial beings gather to receive the oblations offered in the Horse Ritual conducted by King Dasharatha. They are perturbed at the atrocities of Ravana, and request Brahma to think for a way to eliminate Ravana. Vishnu arrives there and pacifies Brahma and other celestials with an assurance that he will incarnate as human to eliminate Ravana.

भागसूचना
  1. ऋष्यशृंगद्वारा राजा दशरथके पुत्रेष्टि यज्ञका आरम्भ, देवताओंकी प्रार्थनासे ब्रह्माजीका रावणके वधका उपाय ढूँढ़ निकालना तथा भगवान् विष्णुका देवताओंको आश्वासन देना
त्र्यम्बकः - धर्माकूतम्

पञ्चदशे सर्गे -

item.title: ०१६ पायसप्रदानम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book I : Bala Kanda - The Youthful Majesties Chapter [Sarga] 16 Verses converted to UTF_8 Sept, 09

Vishnu agrees to incarnate as human and selects Dasharatha as his father. And when Dasharatha is performing the Vedic ritual called putrakaameSTi a deity called praajaapatya-puruSha arises from the sacrificial fire to give a golden vessel of divine dessert to Dasharatha for distribution among his queens to beget progeny. The three queens on consuming that dessert conceive their children.

भागसूचना
  1. देवताओंका श्रीहरिसे रावणवधके लिये मनुष्यरूपमें अवतीर्ण होनेको कहना, राजाके पुत्रेष्टि यज्ञमें अग्निकुण्डसे प्राजापत्य पुरुषका प्रकट होकर खीरअर्पण करना और उसे खाकर रानियोंका गर्भवती होना
त्र्यम्बकः - धर्माकूतम्

षोडशे सर्गे — “ततो नारायणो देवः” इत्य्-आरभ्य “सुराणां विष्णुर् आत्मवान्” -इत्य्-अन्तेन देवैर् उपाय-प्रतिपादन-पूर्वकं प्रार्थितो विष्णुः ॥

item.title: ०१७ ऋक्षवानरोत्पत्तिः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book I : Bala Kanda - The Youthful Majesties

The gods become progenitors Vanara heroes at the dictate of Brahma to come to the aid of Rama in annihilating Ravana. The monkey-like Vanara race is procreated by numerous celestials endowing it with peculiar mighty physique and particular power to come to the help of Rama.

भागसूचना
  1. ब्रह्माजीकी प्रेरणासे देवता आदिके द्वारा विभिन्न वानरयूथपतियोंकी उत्पत्ति
त्र्यम्बकः - धर्माकूतम्

सप्तदशे सर्गे -

item.title: ०१८ रामजन्म
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book I : Bala Kanda - The Youthful Majesties

After the completion of Vedic ritual all the kings and Sage Rishyasringa took leave of Dasharatha and went away to their countries. After some time Rama, Lakshmana, Bharata, and Shatrughna are born. Their virtues in childhood and rituals connected thereto are depicted here. Dasharatha then contemplates the marriages of the princes, since marrying sons after completion of education is customary. At that juncture Sage Vishvamitra arrives at the court of Dasharatha seeking help from the king. Dasharatha receives him adoring in high esteem.

भागसूचना
  1. राजाओं तथा ऋष्यशृंगको विदा करके राजा दशरथका रानियोंसहित पुरीमें आगमन, श्रीराम, भरत, लक्ष्मण तथा शत्रुघ्नके जन्म, संस्कार, शील-स्वभाव एवं सद‍्गुण, राजाके दरबारमें विश्वामित्रका आगमन और उनका सत्कार
त्र्यम्बकः - धर्माकूतम्

अष्टादशे सर्गे -
